derivation: Worked by hand before the engine existed. Fifty weekdays from Monday 2024-01-01 (ten ISO weeks, day index d, Wednesday of week w is d = 5(w-1)+2). Safe asset is flat at 100. Equity is 100 until d15, 90 on d16..d21, 99 on d22..d39, 108.9 from d40. Signals: only trend can fire (window 2, so it votes negative when the previous close fell); the other two thresholds are unreachable. Ladder: step 0 = 80% equity, step 1 = 60%, confirmation 1, no cooldown, uncapped moves, no spread, drift band 0.5. Start 100000 at 80/20 = 80000 equity / 20000 safe. d16: equity -10% -> 72000, total 92000. Week 1 Wednesday has too little history for the volatility signal (data gap, hold). d17 (Wednesday week 4): the d16 close fell, trend negative, step 0 -> 1: equity 0.6*92000 = 55200, safe 36800, traded 2*(72000-55200) = 33600. d22 (Wednesday week 5): d20 and d21 closes equal, trend not negative, re-entry to 0.8 after equity rose 90 -> 99 (x1.1): equity 55200*1.1 = 60720, total 97520; 0.8*97520 = 78016 equity, 19504 safe, traded 2*(78016-60720) = 34592. d40: equity x1.1 -> 85817.6, total 105321.6. No other decision moves (weights stay within the band, ladder holds). Total traded 33600+34592 = 68192.
